description: This file contains unit tests for the GenerateSerializationAttributesAnalyzer, which checks that classes, structs, and records marked with [GenerateSerializer] have appropriate [Id] attributes on their fields for Orleans serialization.

classes.name: GenerateSerializationAttributesAnalyzerTest
classes.description: Unit test class for verifying the behavior of GenerateSerializationAttributesAnalyzer, ensuring it detects missing [Id] attributes on fields of [GenerateSerializer] marked types.

methods.name: VerifyGeneratedDiagnostic
methods.description: Helper method that verifies the diagnostic issued by the analyzer for a given code snippet, ensuring it matches the expected rule ID and severity.

methods.name: SerializableClass
methods.description: Test method checking that a class marked with [GenerateSerializer] and having a field without [Id] attribute triggers the diagnostic.

methods.name: SerializableStruct
methods.description: Test method checking that a struct marked with [GenerateSerializer] and having a field without [Id] attribute triggers the diagnostic.

methods.name: SerializableRecord
methods.description: Test method checking that a record marked with [GenerateSerializer] and having a field without [Id] attribute triggers the diagnostic.

methods.name: SerializableRecordClass
methods.description: Test method checking for the same condition on a record class marked with [GenerateSerializer].

methods.name: SerializableRecordStruct
methods.description: Test method checking for the same condition on a record struct marked with [GenerateSerializer].
